subject: The secret mistake I made with my own dog's food
preview_text: I almost ruined my dog's progress with this one common feeding error. Here's what I discovered instead.
body_paragraphs: I was so focused on measuring my own dog's kibble that I completely missed the real problem. It wasn't the main meals. It was the tiny handful of treats I'd give him throughout the day, thinking 'it's just a little bit.' I was wrong, and it stalled his weight loss for weeks.

I've never posted this on Instagram or Twitter because it's too easy for people to misunderstand without the full context. This is the kind of thing I only share with actual PupShape users who get it. The truth is, most 'healthy' treats are still packed with calories that wreck your dog's daily budget. I had to completely rethink how I reward my dog.

That's why I built the Treat Swap feature inside the app. It shows you lower-calorie alternatives for every common treat, so you can still spoil your dog without undoing a week of progress in five minutes. It's the single biggest hack for consistent weight loss.

Open the app and tap 'Treat Swap' in the meal plan section. I'll show you exactly what to give instead of those high-calorie biscuits. P.S. The swap for peanut butter treats is so good, my dog actually prefers it now. He has no idea he's eating healthier.
